title: Favorites: heart toggle on detail, hearts on every card (web + native)
description: The curation store becomes visible: a heart toggle next to the detail page title, a small heart chip on every web-skin card's art, and a heart marker on native layout tiles. Deliberately separate from the source badges (Custom/Mac/Windows), so it isn't affected by the hide-badges setting.
